# CockroachDB .NET Library

Guide for coding agents working in an app that depends on CockroachDB.DotNet.*:
https://cockroachlabs.github.io/cockroachdb-dotnet-library/agents/AGENTS.md

A copy that matches your package version is bundled at the root of the
CockroachDB.DotNet.Core nupkg. If the two disagree, trust the nupkg copy.
